## Ticket
<!-- Link the issue and use the BZR key in the PR title, e.g. BZR-123 -->

## Context
<!-- What problem are we solving and for whom? -->

## Root cause
<!-- What actually causes it, and how do you know? -->

## Change
<!-- What does this PR do? Keep it to one concern. -->

## Evidence
<!-- Before and after: metrics, query plans, screenshots, profiles. Say how you measured. -->

## Risk and rollback plan
<!-- What could go wrong, and how do we undo it? -->

## Migration notes
<!-- Schema or data changes, lock behaviour, deploy order across repos. "None" is a valid answer. -->

## Test plan
<!-- Tests added or updated, and what you checked by hand. -->
